entries.name: Frostbitten Husk
entries.flavor: It marched through the freeze rather than around it, and never quite thawed all the way through.

entries.name: Verdant Tendril
entries.flavor: Grafted on for one purpose: to close around whatever gets close enough to graft.

entries.name: Pod of the Seedfall
entries.flavor: It was never going to root where it landed. It just needed you to stop moving.

entries.name: Moldering Rind
entries.flavor: What's left after the good part rotted away still knows how to spread.

entries.name: Seething Gall
entries.flavor: A single growth swollen with everything the swarm couldn't finish eating.

entries.name: Husk of the Murmuration
entries.flavor: It hums along with the flock, and after a while so does whatever's listening.

entries.name: Bramble of the Barrow
entries.flavor: Its roots found what the ground was hiding, and never stopped drinking.

entries.name: Charnel Bloat
entries.flavor: Swollen past what the field ever meant to hold, and still finding room to grow.

entries.name: Drifting Kernel
entries.flavor: It never picks a direction. The wind was always going to pick one for it.

entries.name: Permafrost Marrow
entries.flavor: The cold got into the bone years ago and set up permanent residence there.

entries.name: Rusted Bulb
entries.flavor: Requisitioned, painted over, and swelling right on schedule regardless.

entries.name: Riveted Sprig
entries.flavor: Somebody bolted a green thing to the chassis. Nobody's told it that's unusual.

entries.name: Earthen Cutting
entries.flavor: It struck root in packed ground and simply never stopped pushing.

entries.name: Scion of the Overhaul
entries.flavor: Every part they stripped off the old frame came back sharper on the new one.

entries.name: Smoldering Bloom
entries.flavor: It opens once, on the last warm day before the frost, and it burns like it knows.

entries.name: Root of the Rampart
entries.flavor: It grew through the wall instead of around it, and came out the other side still hungry.

entries.name: Scudding Vine
entries.flavor: It never roots long enough to be caught, or to stop cutting.

entries.name: Chitin of the Undertow
entries.flavor: Shed a dozen times by whatever the swarm dragged under, and still not satisfied.

entries.name: Bloom of the Equinox
entries.flavor: It keeps the one balanced day of the year folded tight inside itself, waiting to spend it.

entries.name: Clockwork Graft
entries.flavor: It detonates exactly once, exactly on schedule, and the gears never ask what it costs the rest of you.

entries.name: Cinder-Bolt Spire
entries.flavor: A jagged, charred rod of obsidian that radiates a heat so absolute it leaves nothing behind but ash.

entries.name: Iron-Skull Impact
entries.flavor: A heavy, dented iron helmet that vibrates with the force of a thousand headbutts.

entries.name: Three-Line Volley
entries.flavor: A trio of semi-ripe cherry stems bound by necrotic twine, designed to launch projectiles in rapid succession.

entries.name: Frozen Obstacle
entries.flavor: A solid, unmoving block of frozen cream that reveals itself only when stepped upon.

entries.name: Scorched Volley
entries.flavor: A cluster of charred, pepper-like seeds encased in a volatile, expanding glass sphere.

entries.name: Cactus Needle Volley
entries.flavor: A cluster of jagged, emerald-hued needles that vibrate with kinetic energy, ready to launch in a sudden, overwhelming burst.

entries.name: Iron Gate Ransom
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted iron padlock fused to a collection of human teeth and jagged scrap metal, symbolizing the hostage's desperate grip on life.

entries.name: Corporate Blitz
entries.flavor: A heavy, leather-wrapped ball of stitched flesh and industrial steel, smelling of fresh turf and stale office air.

entries.name: Tri-Line Venous Vial
entries.flavor: A glass vessel containing three pulsating, toxic veins of ichor that rhythmically throb with a sickly glow.

entries.name: The Major Arcana Shell
entries.flavor: A heavy, metallic canister etched with tarot symbols, designed to launch high-velocity peas.

entries.name: Spike-Shot Core
entries.flavor: A jagged, pressurized canister of hardened obsidian that vibrates with kinetic energy.

entries.name: Splatter-Seed Launcher
entries.flavor: A heavy, pulpy orb of pressurized fruit rind that bursts upon impact, coating the battlefield in sticky, damaging juice.

entries.name: The Paper Bulwark
entries.flavor: A folded newspaper, its ink bleeding into a grey, pulsating mass of brain matter that refuses to be read.

entries.name: Kinetic Aperture
entries.flavor: A polished brass lens that vibrates with the tension of a coiled spring, ready to release a concentrated burst of energy.

entries.name: Spore-Scented Panic
entries.flavor: A hollowed, trembling fungal bulb that rhythmically ejects clouds of toxic dust at anything that draws near.

entries.name: Glacial Spikes
entries.flavor: A jagged, frost-coated rod of permafrost that vibrates with the kinetic energy of a thousand discharged rounds.

entries.name: Trifecta Volley
entries.flavor: A series of three parallel metal rods, aligned and tensioned to release a single, devastating kinetic burst.

entries.name: Pattern-Shift Array
entries.flavor: A rotating prism of shifting alloys that reconfigures its internal geometry to redistribute kinetic energy into concentrated bursts of fire.

entries.name: Puncture Spore
entries.flavor: A cluster of jagged, rubberized thorns that pulse with a slow, necrotic rhythm.

entries.name: Gnash-Bloom
entries.flavor: A cluster of petrified, tooth-filled petals that pulse with a rhythmic, hungry tremor.

entries.name: Iron-Gate Spore
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted iron gate shaped like a mushroom cap, constantly venting thick, pressurized grey smoke from its gills.

entries.name: Visceral Vapors
entries.flavor: A translucent, pulsating bladder filled with caustic, swirling bile.

entries.name: Gorged Maw Fragment
entries.flavor: A pulsating, fleshy petal harvested from a corpse, still twitching with a hunger that never fades.

entries.name: Spike-Core Fuse
entries.flavor: A jagged, pressurized sphere of volatile obsidian shards that crackles with heat and rough, uneven textures.

entries.name: Spined Solar Spike
entries.flavor: A jagged, crystalline cactus needle that pulses with concentrated solar energy, ready to discharge upon impact.

entries.name: Lumen Beam
entries.flavor: A polished glass cylinder containing a concentrated, oscillating filament of pure light that pulses with every strike.

entries.name: Glacial Spire
entries.flavor: A jagged, frost-rimed shard of permafrost that vibrates with the tension of a drawn bowstring.

entries.name: Winter Sprout Hearth
entries.flavor: A heavy, ceramic vessel shaped like a budding bamboo shoot, containing a glowing ember that absorbs heat to create a barrier of thick, steaming soil.

entries.name: Abyssal Maw
entries.flavor: A cluster of calcified, tooth-lined petals that pulse with a rhythmic, swallowing motion.

entries.name: Relentless Salvo
entries.flavor: A heavy, brass-plated drum magazine that vibrates with the rhythm of continuous fire.

entries.name: Spore-Cloud Reliquary
entries.flavor: A heavy, damp vessel shaped like a bloated cap, constantly venting thick, melancholic grey mists and fine spores.

entries.name: Spore-Cloud Siphon
entries.flavor: A pulsating, translucent bulb of bioluminescent sea-grass and decaying fungal matter that rhythmically ejects thick, choking clouds of spores.

entries.name: Rolling Grave-Nut
entries.flavor: A heavy, spherical nut shell that rolls with the unstoppable momentum of a bowling ball, crushing everything in its path like a relentless tide of the undead.

entries.name: Rolling Grave-Nut
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished nut shell that rolls with the weight of a bowling ball, leaving a trail of necrotic rot in its wake.

entries.name: Black Olive Vanguard's Talon
entries.flavor: A heavy, serrated obsidian claw, etched with the sigils of a thousand battle-lines, worn as a heavy mantle to crush any opponent who dares stand in the way of the formation.

entries.name: Unfathomable Vanguard
entries.flavor: A heavy, matte-black obsidian monolith that pulses with a rhythm no one can hear, shaped like a blunt spearhead that seems to absorb all light.

entries.name: Iron-Face Volley
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished obsidian cylinder etched with the insignia of the lieutenant, designed to vibrate with the rhythm of relentless gunfire.

entries.name: The Unfair Scrimmage
entries.flavor: A heavy, leather-wrapped sphere of dense, dark matter that pulses with the rhythmic, angry thud of a thousand marching feet.

entries.name: Iron-Masked Pivot
entries.flavor: A heavy, medieval-forged iron mask shaped like a basketball, mounted on a thick wooden pedestal.

entries.name: Mist-Bound Clover
entries.flavor: A cluster of translucent, green-tinted balloons filled with thick, swirling fog, tied together by decaying hemp strings.

entries.name: Iron-Skin Tuber
entries.flavor: A heavy, reinforced potato encased in jagged iron plating, designed to detonate upon impact with the earth.

entries.name: Spore Volleyer
entries.flavor: A collection of hardened, spherical fungal heads lashed together with dried vines, designed to be launched like projectiles.

entries.name: Coiled Spring Core
entries.flavor: A tightly wound, spring-like vegetable core that vibrates with kinetic potential, ready to launch projectiles at high velocity.

entries.name: Cabbage Core Volley
entries.flavor: A dense, layered sphere of tightly wound leafy matter that launches heavy, high-velocity projectiles.

entries.name: Sky-Piercing Unit
entries.flavor: A collection of airborne, needle-like spikes that strike with sudden, singular force.

entries.name: Spore-Jet Spire
entries.flavor: A long, hollowed cactus stalk filled with pressurized gas, designed to launch concentrated spores at high velocity.

entries.name: Spiny Balloon Nut
entries.flavor: A pressurized, elongated husk covered in needle-like protrusions that expands when struck.

entries.name: Undead Salvo
entries.flavor: A heavy, rattling canister made of bone and lead, constantly leaking a dark, necrotic mist that accelerates the firing rate of every soldier on the field.

entries.name: Spiked Bloom
entries.flavor: A translucent, water-lily shaped bladder filled with pressurized gas, studded with sharp, needle-like thorns.

entries.name: Floating Cherry Impact
entries.flavor: A suspended, bruised cherry that pulses with a rhythmic, necrotic thrum.

entries.name: Sinew-Bound Burst
entries.flavor: A pair of swollen, glistening cherries bound together by a fuse of braided sinew, pulsing with a rhythmic, dark heat.

entries.name: Perfect Cherry Burst
entries.flavor: A polished cherry-shaped casing that conceals a volatile, explosive core, designed to shatter upon impact.

entries.name: Fermented Volley
entries.flavor: A pressurized cluster of glowing, necrotic cherries encased in a dark, organic barrel that pulses with a rhythmic, restless heartbeat.

entries.name: Cherry-Shot Husk
entries.flavor: A preserved, shriveled cherry stem fused to a dried mushroom cap, shaped like a crude, organic crossbow bolt.

entries.name: Spicy Grave-Burst
entries.flavor: A jagged, dried chili pod encased in a translucent, pulsating resin that smells of sulfur and scorched earth.

entries.name: Panic-Burst Cherry
entries.flavor: A trembling, overripe cherry-shaped bulb that swells with indignant heat before detonating in a fit of rage.

entries.name: Elite Schoolgirl's Cherry Volley
entries.flavor: A polished, high-grade wooden launcher shaped like a ceremonial school emblem, smelling faintly of sweet blossoms and old parchment.

entries.name: Explosive Cherry Core
entries.flavor: A volatile, spherical fruit made of hardened red resin, containing a pressurized, sparking fuse that pulses with aggressive energy.

entries.name: Adventurer's Talon
entries.flavor: A jagged, serrated shard of hardened bone and rusted iron, shaped like a predatory beak, vibrating with the frantic energy of a sudden strike.

entries.name: Coach's Command Baton
entries.flavor: A weathered wooden pole, stained by the soil of many graves, which vibrates with a command that forces the dead to rise and march.

entries.name: 粘稠减速带
entries.flavor: A thick, yellow, viscous slab of butter that clings to the ground, making movement impossible for enemies.

entries.name: Spore-Burst Crown
entries.flavor: A pulsating, gelatinous mass of yellow fungus that sits atop the commander's head, rhythmically spraying a thick, intoxicating mist that forces enemies to experience a sudden, overwhelming surge of necrotic vitality.

entries.name: Corn Kernel Stasis
entries.flavor: A viscous, golden butter coating that hardens instantly upon contact, trapping enemies in a sweet, starchy prison.

entries.name: 僵尸之感
entries.flavor: A petrified, nut-like relic that forces a sudden, overwhelming realization upon the mind, freezing the soul in place.

entries.name: Starch-Cased Volley
entries.flavor: A stout, ribbed canister of hardened starch and polished amber, packed with kernels of concentrated sunlight.

entries.name: Alarm Clock of the Crimson Whale
entries.flavor: A heavy, soot-stained brass mechanism shaped like a ticking alarm clock, vibrating with the restless fury of a worker forced from a dream.

entries.name: Cabbage Ember-Core
entries.flavor: A dense, leafy sphere of charred vegetation that pulses with internal heat, ready to be hurled at any target.

entries.name: 毁灭樱桃之核
entries.flavor: 由深红色的樱桃果实与破碎的毁灭晶体交织而成，其核心不断释放着毁灭性的能量波动。

entries.name: Grave-Bloom Maw
entries.flavor: A pulsating, necrotic bulb made of petrified vines and teeth, constantly twitching as if attempting to swallow the air itself.

entries.name: Cinder-Sower's Command
entries.flavor: A heavy, charred husk of a corn-cob, fused with molten slag and shaped into a ceremonial baton used to direct the volley.

entries.name: Cinder-Pit Crucible
entries.flavor: A heavy, hollowed sphere of scorched clay and cooling magma, designed to crater the earth upon impact.

entries.name: Thesis of Kinetic Attrition
entries.flavor: A heavy, lead-lined drafting compass fused with a spent shell casing, vibrating with the rhythmic, mindless joy of a repetitive calculation.

entries.name: 毁灭豌豆射手之友
entries.flavor: 由坚硬的豌豆外壳与闪烁着毁灭光芒的藤蔓编织而成，它在颤抖中紧贴着指挥官，仿佛在寻求保护，却又在关键时刻释放出毁灭性的力量。

entries.name: 余烬之光
entries.flavor: A glass-encased filament of dying embers that pulses with a sudden, violent burst of concentrated light.

entries.name: Spore-Bomb Spore-Burst
entries.flavor: A pulsating, bulbous fungal mass that rhythmically expands and contracts, leaking volatile gas from its gills before detonating in a violent spray of spores.

entries.name: Death's Whistling Bolt
entries.flavor: A jagged, hollowed obsidian bolt that hums with a high-pitched, predatory whistle when drawn, designed to pierce through the very essence of life.

entries.name: Spiked Vine Core
entries.flavor: A dense, pulsating knot of thorny vines and hardened sap that thrums with aggressive vitality.

entries.name: Spore-Burst Helianthus
entries.flavor: A heavy, bulbous seed pod shaped like a scorched sunflower head, filled with volatile, glowing spores that tremble with the threat of detonation.

entries.name: Triple-Line Ruin
entries.flavor: A heavy, three-pronged projectile made of dark, serrated metal that hums with destructive energy.

entries.name: Embering Stump
entries.flavor: A charred, hollowed-out piece of ancient wood, perpetually glowing with an internal heat that radiates from its jagged core.

entries.name: Crimson Kinetic Core
entries.flavor: A pair of polished, pulsating spheres fused by a translucent stem, vibrating with the internal pressure of high-velocity nectar.

entries.name: Glacial Conduit
entries.flavor: A pair of translucent, frost-rimed cylinders that pulse with rhythmic kinetic energy, ejecting rapid-fire projectiles of solidified sleet.

entries.name: Trident Engine Salvo
entries.flavor: A heavy, combustion-driven relic shaped like a three-pronged engine block, designed to pour out a relentless torrent of ordinance.

entries.name: Trident of the Riverbed
entries.flavor: A rusted, three-pronged iron relic, shaped like a ceremonial athlete's trophy, salvaged from the silt of a dried-up riverbed.

entries.name: Cabbage Shell Volley
entries.flavor: A tightly wound, leafy sphere that acts as a protective dome before snapping open to launch hard, seed-like projectiles.

entries.name: Cabbage Volley Core
entries.flavor: A dense, layered sphere of tightly wound green leaves that pulses with kinetic energy, ready to burst upon impact.

entries.name: Reflected Spikes
entries.flavor: A jagged shard of obsidian-like earth, pulsing with an inner magma that casts dancing, sharp shadows of light.

entries.name: Reflecting Ember-Vine
entries.flavor: A tangled mass of translucent aquatic flora, pulsing with an inner heat that mirrors the soul of the depths.

entries.name: Ascendant Phoenix Plume
entries.flavor: A soaring shaft of iridescent down and tempered wind-glass, shaped like a rising wing to catch the updrafts of battle.

entries.name: Phoenix Crestlet
entries.flavor: A jagged, molten shard of a fallen phoenix wing, shaped into a ceremonial arrowhead that radiates intense heat.

entries.name: Cabbage Volleyer
entries.flavor: A spring-loaded, leafy sphere that smells pungent and bounces with aggressive momentum.

entries.name: Pea-Pod Volleyer
entries.flavor: A heavy, brass-bound canister shaped like a swollen garlic bulb, constantly rattling with the sound of hard, green seeds striking metal.

entries.name: Dual-Handed Garlic Pod
entries.flavor: A pair of fleshy, bulbous hands carved from pungent garlic cloves, designed to launch green peas with explosive force.

entries.name: Miasmic Cultivator
entries.flavor: A glass canister filled with swirling, pressurized smog that leaks microscopic spores whenever the commander breathes.

entries.name: Unwavering Volley
entries.flavor: A heavy, leaden cylinder of black olive-wood and scrap iron, vibrating with the rhythmic, stubborn pulse of a thousand marching boots.

entries.name: Trembling Shell-Casing
entries.flavor: A hollowed, rusted shell that vibrates with the frantic rhythm of a nervous trigger finger.

entries.name: Nightfall Volley of the Scholar
entries.flavor: A heavy, brass-bound tome leaking dark ink and cherry-scented smoke, vibrating with the frantic rhythm of a thousand reloading chambers.

entries.name: The Exile's Last Supper
entries.flavor: A heavy, ceramic pie dish filled with thick, crimson cherry preserves, smelling faintly of home and gunpowder.

entries.name: Pea-Shot Spore
entries.flavor: A cluster of tiny, hard green spheres encased in a hollowed-out mushroom cap, designed to rattle and launch with rapid force.

entries.name: Gilded Ruin Anchor
entries.flavor: A heavy, solid gold mushroom cap that radiates a crushing weight, turning the very ground into a stable tomb for enemies.

entries.name: Magnetic Salvo
entries.flavor: A heavy, rotating cylinder of magnetized lead, pulsing with a rhythmic hum that draws incoming projectiles toward its core.

entries.name: Golden Rind Volley
entries.flavor: A massive, gilded melon shell that splits upon impact, raining heavy seeds upon the enemy.

entries.name: The Swarming Conduit
entries.flavor: A tangled mass of rusted copper wiring and necrotic sinew, pulsing with a frantic, mindless energy that draws the dead toward the fray.

entries.name: Secret Recipe Spikes
entries.flavor: A cluster of frozen cactus needles, shaped like a jagged ice cone, ready to launch at the slightest touch.

entries.name: Spore-Casing Volley
entries.flavor: A dense, calcified mushroom cap that vibrates with internal pressure, ready to release a cloud of piercing spores.

entries.name: The Iron Oval
entries.flavor: A heavy, bullet-shaped hunk of reinforced lead, shaped like a pro-league ball, etched with commands that stir the restless dead.

entries.name: The Unstoppable Grinder
entries.flavor: A heavy, jagged slab of volcanic whetstone, perpetually shedding sparks that smell of sulfur and old blood.

entries.name: Resonant Grave-Pulse
entries.flavor: A translucent, water-filled vessel containing a swirling mass of spectral remains that pulses with a rhythmic, hypnotic light.

entries.name: Fungal Necromancer's Spore-Locket
entries.flavor: A pulsating, violet-veined mushroom cap encased in a cage of calcified bone, releasing rhythmic puffs of intoxicating, necrotic spores.

entries.name: Spore-Cloud Effigy
entries.flavor: A hollowed, bloated fungal mass that constantly leaks thick, choking smog.

entries.name: Pea-Shot Siphon
entries.flavor: A polished brass canister filled with enchanted, swelling green legumes that pulse with a hypnotic, rhythmic glow.

entries.name: Unseen Mine-Trap
entries.flavor: A jagged, spicy ore shard that pulses with a hidden heat, waiting for a companion to trigger its sudden eruption.

entries.name: The Ripe Swarm
entries.flavor: A heavy, pulpy orb of fermented melon flesh, studded with jagged teeth and animated by restless, necrotic energy.

entries.name: Biting Husk
entries.flavor: A jagged, petrified nut shell that pulses with a rhythmic, necrotic hunger, occasionally snapping shut on anything nearby.

entries.name: Spore-Bite Totem
entries.flavor: A shrunken, petrified mushroom cap that pulses with a sickly green light, smelling faintly of damp earth and decay.

entries.name: Hollowed Gourd of the Swarm
entries.flavor: A heavy, swollen pumpkin carved into a vessel, overflowing with thick, necrotic sludge that pulses like a heartbeat.

entries.name: Gourd of Overwhelming Allure
entries.flavor: A heavy, pulsating squash carved from obsidian and wrapped in intoxicatingly sweet vines, designed to crush the will of any who gaze upon it.

entries.name: Echoing Volley of the Blighted Stump
entries.flavor: A charred, hollowed-out stump that pulses with a rhythmic, necrotic light, acting as a stationary turret for the undead.

entries.name: Frozen Cabbage Core
entries.flavor: A tightly wound, frost-covered cabbage head that pulses with a frantic, icy excitement whenever it makes contact.

entries.name: Frozen Tail Relic
entries.flavor: A preserved, frost-covered tail segment of a winter-born demon, pulsing with a cold, necrotic blue light.

entries.name: Frost-Petal Deck
entries.flavor: A collection of frozen cherry blossom petals, shaped into razor-sharp cards that absorb the heat of passing projectiles.

entries.name: Frost-Kernel Volley
entries.flavor: A frozen corn cob, sculpted into a jagged cone of ice, ready to launch crystalline kernels at high velocity.

entries.name: Glacial Grave-Bloom
entries.flavor: A frozen, crystalline fungal mass that pulses with the rhythm of a dying world, turning the battlefield into a graveyard of frost.

entries.name: Frost-Mist Spore-Caster
entries.flavor: A heavy, frosted glass vessel shaped like a bloated mushroom cap, constantly venting a thick, freezing fog that obscures the battlefield.

entries.name: Frost-Spike Volley
entries.flavor: A cluster of crystalline sub-species shards that emit a cold, scattering light upon impact.

entries.name: Frozen Core Spore
entries.flavor: A dense, frost-coated tuber that vibrates with kinetic energy, ready to expand and detonate upon impact.

entries.name: Luminescent Frost-Lantern
entries.flavor: A frozen, glowing streetlamp casing that pulses with a rhythmic, necrotic light, emitting a chilling mist from its cracked glass.

entries.name: Glacial Bloom Vessel
entries.flavor: A ceramic pot of frozen flora, where the heat of the petals is instantly trapped and turned into solid ice.

entries.name: Frost-Sprout Needle
entries.flavor: A tiny, frozen shard of ice shaped like a budding mushroom, designed to launch freezing projectiles.

entries.name: Frozen Spore Reliquary
entries.flavor: A translucent, frost-rimed pumpkin shell containing a pulsating, crystalline mushroom that releases a burst of frigid energy upon impact.

entries.name: Spore-Frost Reliquary
entries.flavor: A frozen, hollowed fungal bulb that pulses with a rhythmic, terrified tremor, releasing a mist of jagged ice-spores.

entries.name: Spike King's Scepter
entries.flavor: A jagged, frozen rod of permafrost that pulses with the weight of a subterranean monarch.

entries.name: Glacial Gourd Core
entries.flavor: A dense, frost-rimed melon carved from permafrost, pulsing with concentrated kinetic energy.

entries.name: Frost-Bitten Splinter
entries.flavor: A jagged, frozen stump core that fires shards of compressed rime like ballistic slugs.

entries.name: Mimicry Core
entries.flavor: A shifting, iridescent sphere of liquid mercury that constantly reconfigures its surface to mirror the last thing it struck.

entries.name: Scepter of the Hollow King
entries.flavor: A jagged, blackened scepter carved from ancient tombstone marble, topped with a flickering jack-o'-lantern skull that pulses with necrotic energy.

entries.name: Hardened Kernel Volley
entries.flavor: A heavy, metallic canister filled with dense, unyielding corn kernels that strike with the force of stone.

entries.name: Iron-Shell Volley
entries.flavor: A heavy, reinforced canister that launches projectiles with crushing force.

entries.name: Star-Spiked Shell
entries.flavor: A heavy, star-shaped carapaced vessel that launches jagged starfruit shards with kinetic force.

entries.name: Jalacaltrop Cluster
entries.flavor: A cluster of jagged, obsidian-edged spikes that pulse with a dull, internal heat, feeling like a collection of heated needles waiting to pierce anything that dares to tread upon its scorched territory.

entries.name: Boiling Kernel
entries.flavor: A pressurized, glowing husk of a kernel that pulses with heat, ready to burst upon impact.

entries.name: Verdant Combustion Knot
entries.flavor: A dense, pulsating mass of crimson-veined aquatic flora, tightly wound into a sphere that radiates intense heat.

entries.name: Sprouting Detonator
entries.flavor: A heavy, starch-filled tuber wrapped in volatile, spicy fibers that swells with pressure until it bursts.

entries.name: Gourd of Total Might
entries.flavor: A massive, hollowed pumpkin shell reinforced with iron bands, acting as a vessel for concentrated kinetic energy.

entries.name: Bursting Pod Launcher
entries.flavor: A heavy, swollen seed pod made of hardened green husk, designed to rupture and propel its contents with explosive force.

entries.name: Tangled Earth-Spark
entries.flavor: A clump of wet, tuberous roots entwined with conductive sea-grass, pulsing with static electricity.

entries.name: Edgar's Greeting
entries.flavor: A lightweight, hollowed-out fuselage fragment, etched with the silhouette of a massive airship, used to signal the arrival of a tactical bombardment.

entries.name: Data-Stream Bomber
entries.flavor: A heavy, monolithic slab of polished obsidian and glowing circuitry, pulsing with the rhythm of a thousand synchronized engines.

entries.name: Luminous Spore-Core
entries.flavor: A pulsating, translucent fungal bulb that emits a continuous, blinding radiance, acting as a beacon for overwhelming energy.

entries.name: Continuous Beam Array
entries.flavor: A series of interlocking, high-frequency laser lenses that hum with the vibration of a constant, advancing firing line.

entries.name: Kinetic Sphere of the Grave
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished obsidian sphere etched with mechanical gears that hums with the weight of descending gravity.

entries.name: 极冰豆弹射器
entries.flavor: A frosted, crystalline canister shaped like a heavy seed, designed to launch frozen projectiles that ricochet upon impact.

entries.name: Magnetic Spines
entries.flavor: A cluster of iron-rich, needle-like cactus spines that pulse with a rhythmic magnetic field, disrupting the flow of enemy movements.

entries.name: Magnetic Nut Orbit
entries.flavor: A cluster of iron-rich nuts spinning in a tight, gravitational dance, pulling nearby allies into its protective orbit.

entries.name: Spike-Thorn Vertigo
entries.flavor: A jagged, pulsating melon-rind shard that causes the world to spin and bodies to recoil upon impact.

entries.name: Volley of the Rind
entries.flavor: A heavy, segmented melon-shell canister, pressurized with explosive juice and ready to be hurled in endless waves.

entries.name: Spattering Vessel
entries.flavor: A heavy, earthenware pot that acts as a launcher, spraying seeds and soil to increase the impact of every strike.

entries.name: Fungal Mortar
entries.flavor: A heavy, earthen base of compressed spores and graveyard soil, designed to launch explosive mushroom caps with devastating force.

entries.name: Rind-Shell Volley
entries.flavor: A thick, green-striped rind shaped into a heavy, hollowed-out sphere, designed to launch seeds at high velocity.

entries.name: Subspecies Core-Meltdown
entries.flavor: A dense, pulsating sphere of radioactive gourd-matter, held in a state of constant, vibrating readiness.

entries.name: Gravel-Maw Fragment
entries.flavor: A jagged, calcified shard of necrotic clay that pulses with a rhythmic, swallowing hunger.

entries.name: Nut-Core Pyre
entries.flavor: A heavy, charred stump of wood, its core filled with glowing, resinous nuts that pulse with an intense, searing light.

entries.name: Obsidian Shard Volley
entries.flavor: A polished, razor-sharp obsidian spike, designed to be hurled with violent momentum.

entries.name: Synchronized Seed-Pod Volley
entries.flavor: A cluster of translucent, vibrating green pods that pulse in unison, ready to release a rapid stream of kinetic energy.

entries.name: Calcified Splinter
entries.flavor: A jagged, aerodynamic spike of hardened nutmeat that pierces through solid matter like a splinter through silk.

entries.name: Rooted Volley Base
entries.flavor: A heavy ceramic planter reinforced with iron bands, designed to absorb the violent kick of rapid-fire seed bursts.

entries.name: Sprout-Shot Spore
entries.flavor: A tiny, pressurized green pod that rhythmically ejects concentrated pea-like spores at high velocity.

entries.name: Seed-Spit Legacy
entries.flavor: A heavy, hollowed gourd carved into a repeating barrel, filled with pressurized seeds that launch with rhythmic precision.

entries.name: Trembling Sprout
entries.flavor: A fragile, translucent pod that vibrates with nervous energy, leaking a bitter sap that accelerates the heartbeat of those nearby.

entries.name: Pulsating Volley
entries.flavor: A gelatinous, emerald mass of twitching orifices that erupts in relentless, torrential waves of pressurized projectiles.

entries.name: Frozen Specimen Vial
entries.flavor: A glass cylinder containing a preserved, frost-covered penguin wing, preserved in a state of eternal, necrotic stasis.

entries.name: Edgar's Ambitious Drill
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished alloy sphere that hums with the restless hunger of a thousand drills, surrounded by a rotating orbit of smaller, jagged metal shards.

entries.name: Deep-Vein Pick
entries.flavor: A heavy, jagged tool forged from raw ore and petrified roots, designed to strike with the weight of the mountain itself.

entries.name: Bursting Spud Fragment
entries.flavor: A cluster of overripe, jagged tuber chunks that violently rupture upon impact.

entries.name: 会长压扁土豆
entries.flavor: A flattened, squashed tuberous mass that refuses to move from its spot.

entries.name: Succulent Spore-Pod
entries.flavor: A fleshy, bulbous pod that swells with pressurized sap, ready to burst and propel its seeds like organic bullets upon impact.

entries.name: Crushing Gourd Totem
entries.flavor: A heavy, hollowed-out gourd shell filled with jagged stones, designed to be dropped upon the heads of foes.

entries.name: Emerald Ricochet
entries.flavor: A polished, faceted emerald shard that vibrates with kinetic energy, causing incoming projectiles to bounce off its surface with increased velocity.

entries.name: Heavy Sphere of the Grave
entries.flavor: A dense, obsidian-like bowling ball etched with weeping red eyes, designed to crush everything in its path with unstoppable momentum.

entries.name: 毁灭者的同伴
entries.flavor: 由无数细小的毁灭性孢子凝聚而成的箭镞，在使用者挥动手臂时会伴随轻微的震颤，仿佛在渴望着下一个目标。

entries.name: Spore Burst Sacrificial Pod
entries.flavor: A swollen, trembling fungal bulb that ruptures upon impact, releasing a cloud of caustic spores at the cost of the host's vitality.

entries.name: Star-Mimicry Shell
entries.flavor: A hollow, star-shaped husk made of dried fungal matter that emits a blinding flash to mask its true, trembling nature.

entries.name: Silt-Choke Spore
entries.flavor: A heavy, sodden mass of decaying fungal tissue that pulses with a rhythmic, suffocating drag.

entries.name: Abyssal Spore-Cactus
entries.flavor: A calcified, ribbed sponge-flesh studded with stinging, coral-like spores that pulse with a bioluminescent, gelatinous glow.

entries.name: Great Spore Bulwark
entries.flavor: A massive, calcified fungal cap that mimics the jagged silhouette of a predator to intimidate foes.

entries.name: Snail-Shell Courage
entries.flavor: A translucent, water-filled shell that pulses with a soft light when its owner finds the strength to strike.

entries.name: Frost-Spore Reliquary
entries.flavor: A frozen, translucent fungal bulb that pulses with a rhythmic, numbing chill, expanding its icy reach to ensnare all nearby foes.

entries.name: Fanged Salvo
entries.flavor: A jagged, hollowed tooth carved from obsidian, pulsating with the kinetic energy of a thousand spent shells.

entries.name: Relic of the Hollow Eye
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted brass scope encased in calcified bone, pulsing with a rhythmic, necrotic light.

entries.name: Brotherhood's Volley
entries.flavor: A polished, gleaming spearhead forged from frozen marrow, designed to be thrown in unison by a coordinated horde.

entries.name: Frost-Shot Reliquary
entries.flavor: A hollowed, frozen skull filled with jagged ice shards, ready to launch at the first sign of movement.

entries.name: Edgar's Precise Pelt
entries.flavor: A preserved, stiffened beast-hide scrap, stitched with uncanny precision to ensure every strike finds its mark.

entries.name: Necrotic Gale-Shard
entries.flavor: A jagged, frost-crusted skull bound by dark, necrotic sinew, ready to eject splintered icicles with violent force.

entries.name: Solaris Impact
entries.flavor: A heavy, molten shell shaped like a falling star, containing a core of compressed sunlight ready to detonate upon contact.

entries.name: Spike-Bed Sower
entries.flavor: A cluster of jagged, obsidian-like thorns embedded in a mound of nutrient-rich, dark soil.

entries.name: Marrow-Splitter
entries.flavor: A jagged, bifurcated vessel of calcified remains that discharges spectral bile with unrelenting force.

entries.name: Spruce Bolt-Husk
entries.flavor: A heavy, splintered crossbow frame carved from petrified spruce, lashed together with the sinew of a restless corpse.

entries.name: Melodic Grave-Link
entries.flavor: A heavy, vibrating bell made of compressed graveyard soil and rusted iron chains, which hums a low, rhythmic dirge that pulls spirits from the earth.

entries.name: Corn-Husk Volley
entries.flavor: A heavy, pressurized canister made of dried, tightly-wound corn husks and rusted iron, designed to spray a chaotic burst of jagged seeds and lead pellets.

entries.name: Drowned Totem of the Many
entries.flavor: A heavy, waterlogged mass of tangled aquatic weeds and calcified remains, shaped like a bloated, upright corpse that pulls everything toward its center.

entries.name: Splintering Husk
entries.flavor: A jagged, hollowed-out shell of dried organic matter, filled with pressurized, bone-like projectiles that shatter upon impact.

entries.name: Star-Spore Volley
entries.flavor: A cluster of five star-shaped fungal caps that split upon impact, releasing a spray of rapid-fire spores.

entries.name: Star-Shaped Spore-Shot
entries.flavor: A translucent, five-pointed star carved from dried star-fruit pulp, pulsing with a rapid, rhythmic light.

entries.name: The Flattened Descent
entries.flavor: A heavy, crushed stone slab shaped like a five-fingered hand, trailing a swarm of restless, undead spirits.

entries.name: Sun-Kissed Clover Volley
entries.flavor: A cluster of glowing three-leaf clovers that pulse with solar energy, periodically exhaling a rapid stream of light-infused seed bullets.

entries.name: Cinder-Sprout Husk
entries.flavor: A dried, blackened pepper pod that pulses with an inner heat, containing the restless spirit of a scorched vine.

entries.name: Solar Flare Starlet
entries.flavor: A jagged, crystalline star made of concentrated sunlight that slowly evaporates, releasing bursts of searing radiation.

entries.name: Cherry Burst Core
entries.flavor: A heavy, spherical vessel made of polished red crystal, containing a pressurized core of explosive cherry nectar that ruptures upon impact.

entries.name: Cherry-Shot Volley
entries.flavor: A polished cherry-wood tube that hums with the restless energy of a thousand seeds waiting to be launched.

entries.name: Stilt-Walker's Spite
entries.flavor: A long, bleached pole of bone that pushes back the living and the dead alike.

entries.name: Gatling Gourd
entries.flavor: A heavy, hollowed-out pumpkin reinforced with iron barrels and a rapid-fire mechanism.

entries.name: Continental Blitz-Ball
entries.flavor: A heavy, dented iron sphere etched with the outlines of the seven continents, used to crush opposition in a relentless charge.

entries.name: Clover of the Rising Rot
entries.flavor: A cluster of three decaying shamrocks, perpetually swelling with necrotic energy and lifting from the soil in a frantic, uncontrolled bloom.

entries.name: Spore Burst Signet
entries.flavor: A pulsating, iridescent fungal bulb that rhythmically releases clouds of shimmering, hallucinogenic spores.

entries.name: Uncrowned Sovereign
entries.flavor: A heavy, three-tiered projectile launcher forged from dense, spring-loaded aquatic reeds, designed to fire bouncing kinetic slugs.

entries.name: Nut-Shell Volley
entries.flavor: A heavy, rotating drum of hardened shells that feeds a continuous stream of projectiles.

entries.name: Glacial Emperor's Relic
entries.flavor: A frozen, hollowed penguin skull encased in a swirling vortex of eternal blizzard winds and jagged ice shards.

entries.name: Champion's Vaulting Pole
entries.flavor: A polished, heavy rod of reinforced bone and gold, designed to launch the wielder with explosive, unrivaled force.

entries.name: Glacial Lotus Bloom
entries.flavor: A cluster of crystalline lotus petals, frozen in a state of perpetual blooming, radiating a numbing frost.

entries.name: Triple-Row Corn-Launcher
entries.flavor: A heavy, three-tiered wooden rack holding polished kernels that pulse with kinetic energy, ready to be hurled in rapid succession.

entries.name: Triple-Line Seed-Slinger
entries.flavor: A heavy, striped gourd carved into a segmented projectile launcher, designed to spit seeds in rapid, rhythmic bursts.

entries.name: Cracked Torch-Stump
entries.flavor: A charred, split stump that continuously leaks molten embers from its fissures.
